title: Above Avalon: Above Avalon Episode 21: Apple's M&A Strategy
text:
Above Avalon: Above Avalon Episode 21: Apple’s M&A Strategy Huffduffed by adewale on September 15th, 2018
A look into Apple’s M&A strategy and why big acquisitions aren’t in Apple’s DNA. Additional topics include Apple’s LinX acquisition, Lisa Jackson’s post about partnering with The Conservation Fund to buy forests, and why Apple doesn’t need $178 billion of cash to change the world. The episode concludes with a theory about how to tell if Apple’s culture is changing.
